answer_1.quote: Open-ended sequence generation problems such as dialog, story generation, image captioning, or causal generation pose a practical challenge to neural sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models ...
answer_1.outputs: diverse generated sequences, e.g., varied causal statements (causes/effects) and other open‑ended outputs

answer_2.quote: We quantitatively compare COD3S against the out‑puts of regular seq2seq beam search ... To measure lexical diversity, we set Δ(y, y ) to be the sentences' inverse (100 minus) BLEU‑1 and -2 scores. To measure semantic diversity, we set Δ to be the cosine distance between their SBERT embeddings.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Our automatic metrics quantify diversity without tracking task effectiveness, which we evaluate by collecing judgments on Amazon Mechanical Turk. We ask workers to judge the plausibility of responses as causal completions (on a 0-5 Likert scale).
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate the plausibility of each generated causal completion on a 0‑5 Likert scale.
